name: follow-ups
description: Writes the follow-ups a session leaves unfinished into your Esposter TodoList, tagged with the repository and session that found them, and drains a repository's follow-ups one change at a time until none is left.

site_url.title: Site
site_url.description: The Esposter site the TodoList lives on, as the list's Connect an agent dialog shows it.

list_id.title: List id
list_id.description: The TodoList the follow-ups go into, as its Connect an agent dialog shows it.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: An API key from API keys in your Esposter settings. Stored in the credential store, never in a settings file.
